 ## RAC Provision was blocked with ASMLIB v3
 ### Here is the Jira for more details on this issue - [https://jira.nutanix.com/browse/ERA-59311]
 ### However, after applying the recently available one-off oracle patch on 19.29(the latest patch available today), RAC provision passed.
 ### It means the one-off patch has the fix for ASMLIB v3 RAC issue, so we decided to qualify with this one-off oracle patch. This one off patch is not released yet, we expect this to be released as part of next oracle patch release due on end of Jan 2026. If this one off patch is not released in upcoming patch release then we decided to document this one patch details in NDB 2.10.1 release notes and mention that this patch needs to be applied in order to get RAC support with ASMLIB v3.
 ## Clone from SIHA ASMLIB v3 is also failing during running Oracle renamedg utility only on Nested AHV 
 ### Initial triaging/RCA is updated in Jira - [https://jira.nutanix.com/browse/ERA-59310]
 ### Since most of the customers are on physical cluster we do not have issue from customer front, still we will be implementing a flag based approach to skip the renamedg so that we can disable renaming dg and clone can passed.
